Record Class ShotGate.Inputs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.robot.subsystems.ShotGate.Inputs
Record Components:
launching - the super state is one that feeds
override - the operator is holding the bypass
nowSeconds - the robot clock (replayed, pinned per loop)
flywheelRpm - measured flywheel speed
flywheelTargetRpm - flywheel speed the shot wants; 0 or less when not on a shot
hoodDeg - measured hood angle
hoodDegPerSec - measured hood speed
hoodTargetDeg - hood angle the shot wants
checkAim - whether heading votes (false when nothing is aiming the drivetrain: the set shot, where the driver aims, and the X-brake launch)
headingErrorRad - fused heading minus the heading being held
aimToleranceRad - start tolerance for headingErrorRad
checkRange - whether range votes (false for the set shot, and while the pose is not trusted, when range is not measuring anything)
shotValid - the distance is inside the shot model's fitted range
Enclosing class:
ShotGate
public static record ShotGate.Inputs(boolean launching, boolean override, double nowSeconds, double flywheelRpm, double flywheelTargetRpm, double hoodDeg, double hoodDegPerSec, double hoodTargetDeg, boolean checkAim, double headingErrorRad, double aimToleranceRad, boolean checkRange, boolean shotValid) extends Record
One loop's view of the shot, every field from a logged input or something computed from one.
